Detailed Description

Builder/parser for the WSC M2 attribute list carried inside an IEEE 1905.1 WSC TLV.

Purpose:

  • Create mode (parse==false): serializes a complete M2 message from m2::config into the provided buffer (adds all mandatory WSC attributes, optional BSS index, and the WFA Vendor Extension: Version2). The class is finalized in network byte order.
  • Parse mode (parse==true): validates and exposes fields of an incoming M2.

Notes

  • This class does not encrypt ConfigData. Provide cfg.iv and cfg.encrypted_settings (produced by the KeyWrap stage) before calling create().
